term 1.explanation: This command fragment configures a routing policy by defining a term within a policy statement, where `[parameter1]` is the policy name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: The term number of the policy statement.

from route-filter 11.11.11.11/32.explanation: This command fragment configures a routing policy to match routes based on a specific prefix (`parameter3`) and prefix length (`parameter4`) within a defined term (`parameter2`) of a policy statement (`parameter1`).

parameters.name: route-filter

parameters.name: prefix-length
parameters.explanation: The length of the route prefix.

exact.explanation: Configures the matching conditions for the policy statement, which accurately matches the given route.
